title: Env Reader with Fail-Fast
prompt: Write `readEnv(env, required)` — env is a plain object standing in for process.env; required is an array of key names. Return the full env object, but throw an Error naming EVERY missing key (comma-separated) instead of failing later at runtime. Missing means absent, empty string, or undefined.

tests.name: collects all missing keys into one error
tests.hint: Filter first, then throw once with the joined list — fail fast, but fail completely.

tests.name: treats empty string as missing
tests.hint: An empty variable is set to nothing — it cannot configure anything.

tests.name: passes through when complete
tests.hint: No missing keys — return the config so the caller can keep working.
